featured_reviews.name: 24 IX C Veer Ramjiyani
featured_reviews.review_text:
After joining these classes, I truly felt a big difference in my studies. The teaching style here is very simple, clear and easy to understand, which makes even difficult topic look easy. The teachers not only teach but also motivate us to study in an interesting way.

One of the best things about this institute is that equal attention is given to every student. If someone has a doubt, the teacher explains it again and again until it is fully clear. The classroom environment is fully positive and friendly,which makes learning even more enjoyable.
Another great points is the focus on regular tests and practice sessions. These help us identify our weak areas and improve on them. What I like the most is that focus is not only on marks but also on building strong concepts for long term understanding.

I can confidently say that these classes not only help in studies but also teach us discipline, confidence, and self-growth.
Truly this is the perfect place for any student who wants to perform well and achieve success.

featured_reviews.name: Pravin Jangid
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a student preparing for competitive exams like IIT-JEE and NEET, joining Thakur Science Academy was a game-changer for me. Here's my honest take:-
- The faculty is highly experienced and approachable.
- They break down complex concepts into digestible parts, which really helped me in Physics and Organic Chemistry.
- Regular doubt-solving sessions made sure no one was left behind.
- The notes are concise yet comprehensive—perfect for last-minute revision.
- Weekly tests and mock exams simulate real exam conditions, which boosted my confidence.
- The classrooms are clean and well-lit, though a bit cramped during peak batches.
- The learning environment is competitive but supportive—everyone’s pushing each other to do better.
- Personal attention: Teachers remembered our names and progress.
- Motivation sessions: These were surprisingly effective in keeping us focused.
- Flexible timings for extra classes before exams.
- Sometimes the batch sizes get too large, making it harder to get one-on-one time.
- More digital resources or online support would be great for remote revision.

featured_reviews.name: Dali Swain
featured_reviews.review_text: Thakur Science Academy has been a game-changer for students! The faculty is incredibly supportive and knowledgeable, making complex concepts feel manageable. The lab facilities are top-notch, and the emphasis on hands-on learning has really helped students grasp the material. The atmosphere is competitive yet collaborative, pushing students to do their best while also encouraging teamwork. Childrens grown so much as a student and a person since joining. Highly recommend for anyone passionate about science.
